capabilities: Publish the active note and linked notes to a Cloudflare Worker
Upload referenced local images and assets
Follow WikiLinks and Markdown links up to a configurable depth
Bind a custom domain or subdomain from the connected Cloudflare account
Update an existing site by re-publishing and write share IDs to frontmatter
extras: Deployment creates Worker and D1 resources in the user's own Cloudflare account; a hosted connection is planned but not yet available. Files over 20 MB cannot be published, and the Cloudflare connection must be included when syncing settings to other devices.
problem: Sharing an Obsidian note as a live website normally requires separate hosting and manual deployment; this turns publishing into a one-click action backed by the user's own Cloudflare account.

relations.evidence: The first deployment creates a private Worker and D1 database in your Cloudflare account.

summary: Publishes the active Markdown note and its linked notes to a Cloudflare Worker site with one click, including local assets and a stable share link.
